name: Watertight BVH Box Traversal Fix
aliases: Robust BVH Ray Traversal with ULP Expansion
Treat BVH boxes as closed sets in ray traversal
definition: A fix for ray traversal precision errors where rays with zero direction components lying exactly in the plane of a box face missed the box due to the slab test inverting zero as a tiny stand-in, computing (hi - o) * inv = 0 * inv = 0, making the slab look empty for t > 0.
summary: This fix prevents grazing rays from missing boxes by expanding bounding volumes by one ULP, ensuring consistent intersections for rays on face planes.
